pages.title: Place template
pages.html:
Overview

Type: City, village, forest, ship, planet…

Region: Where is it? Coast, mountains, borderlands…

Climate & weather: Seasons, light, what the air feels like…

Population: How many people, or how busy is it?

Government: Who rules, and how?

Economy: What keeps it running?

Look & atmosphere

Appearance: Layout, architecture, sights, sounds, smells…

Atmosphere: What it feels like to arrive and stay…

Landmarks: Places within the place that matter…

History & culture

History: Founding, turning points, old wounds…

Culture & customs: Beliefs, food, language, festivals, taboos…

Notable inhabitants: Who lives here, and who is worth knowing?

Story

Role in the story: Why this place matters to the plot or characters…

Dangers & secrets: Threats, hidden places, what can go wrong here…

pages.title: Culture template
pages.html:
Values

What this culture prizes, and what it punishes.

Customs

Greetings, meals, festivals, and everyday manners.

Language

Words, accents, and phrases that mark someone as an insider.

Power

Who leads, who follows, and how disputes are settled.

Friction

What this culture disagrees with its neighbours about.

pages.title: Creature template
pages.html:
Appearance

Size, shape, and the details people notice first.

Habitat

Where it lives and how it survives there.

Behaviour

What it does when undisturbed, hungry, or threatened.

Dangers

How it hurts people, and how people defend themselves.

Story role

What it means in the story beyond being a threat.
